certificate.source_clause: Optimize a planar 3-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (n=1.52) with air incidence (n=1.0). The stack must consist of exactly three lossless constant-index layers in the order: SiO2 (n=1.46), TiO2 (n=2.40), SiO2 (n=1.46). Each layer thickness is a continuous variable bounded between 40 nm and 160 nm. Minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light
